issues: JS crash in the hero carousel: `$('[data-tag]')` matched the first .slide (which also carries data-tag) instead of the price tag, so `[data-tag-name]` was null and the rest of the script (cart, squash, fly, buybar) never initialised

`html{scroll-behavior:smooth}` turned every programmatic scrollTo into an interrupted smooth scroll, so scroll-reveal never fired below the fold: products (mobile), gallery, quote, CTA and footer area rendered as an empty cream void
CTA band: the decorative .balls wrapper was a grid child, pushing the headline to column 2 and stretching the button into a giant bar on row 2
Brand robustness: hero headline highlight and rotating sticker used raw --c-accent; with a dark/grey accent (Drumland) the highlight went muddy grey and the sticker became an unreadable black disc
Product wells read as flat tinted boxes; mixed photos lacked the 'object on a plate' feel promised by the direction
Catalog toolbar: sort pill wrapped under the search field, leaving a ragged right column
fixed: Price tag is now selected by .price-tag; carousel, cart, squash-and-stretch, bezier fly, jelly pill and mobile buybar all initialise again
Removed global smooth scrolling (both pages) so reveals trigger reliably while scrolling
.balls is absolutely positioned behind the CTA band, restoring the text | button layout on home and catalog
Headline highlight uses the primary-derived --tint-deep; sticker uses a 38% accent tint with a soft halo, legible for any accent
Added a soft surface 'plate' disc (with halo, springs on hover) inside every card well on both pages
Catalog tools stay on one line (search + sort pill) aligned right on desktop, wrap on small screens
